title: Teaching without grabbing the keyboard
method: A conceptual sequence for the reflection exercise in this essay. The steps describe a possible practice, not a measured causal effect or a universal rule.
alt: Concept diagram: Hear the expectation — Ask what should have happened and what did.; Locate the difficulty — Separate concept, tool, and environment issues.; Offer a useful clue — Reveal the next distinction without taking over.; Return the action — Let the learner predict, perform, and explain.; Vary one condition — Check understanding beyond the copied sequence..
